title: Very cushioning and non-slip mat that displays every footprint and barely bounces back
text: Very cushioning and non-slip mat that displays every footprint and barely bounces back. This mat is large at 20” wide x 40” long. It has a non-slip bottom, is easy to clean, is very comfortable to stand on, and has a nice weave design. I would have given this 5 stars if it were not for the fact that it holds all my footprints and barely springs back even after a couple of hours (see before use and after use pictures).  The indentations from use are very unattractive. Nevertheless, if one can get past the visible depressions, this definitely cushions the floor in a kitchen work area.

product_metadata.title: Rachael Ray Luxprolyn Premium Anti-Fatigue Kitchen Mat, Black Basket Weave- 20” x 39”
features: RACHAEL RAY LUXPROLYN PREMIUM ANTI-FATIGUE MATS, come in classic textured designs that will fit into any home, office, and more. These mats and are extra thick for comfort and relief of pressure when standing

COMFORT AND SUPPORT, ¾” cushioned foam helps alleviate some of the pressure that you put on your back, feet, and neck when standing for extended periods of time. ANTI-SLIP, each mat has a textured back to better grip smooth surfaces and stay where you need it
MADE OF QUALITY MATERIALS, these mads are constructed of Luxprolyn which is a blend of 80$ polypropylene & 20% Polyester. PVC Foam with PVC Top. Proudly Made in the USA!
WHEN TO USE, Rachael Ray Luxprolyn Premium Anti-Fatigue Mats are perfect for cooking in the kitchen, but also great in the laundry room, or even at work with a stand-up desk
DURABLE AND EASY CLEAN, these mats are stain resistant. However, for general cleaning, wipe mat clean with mild detergent. Floor should be clean and dry before use
description: Rachel Ray Anti-Fatigue Kitchen Mat : Anti-Fatigue Kitchen Mats effectively relieve pressure on your knees, feet and delicate joints in the legs.
